findings.observation: Skin value, heart-shaped outline, full cheeks, sharp brows, chestnut hair, and core resemblance remain, but the large round eyes, shortened midface and nose, and softened jaw make the face read substantially younger and more generic than the mature 29-year summon. Strict adult identity continuity fails.

Both forearms and clenched fists are visibly enlarged and blockier relative to the source’s slimmer relaxed arms, wrists, and hands, violating the no-generic-chibi-inflation requirement.
Brown-chestnut medium-loose hair preserves the side-swept front, gathered side mass, parting, and plum-wrapped section without color or accent drift.

The plum-gray short mantle, unarmored tunic, offset closures, narrow cuffs, divided lower layers, and contrasting boot laces remain legible, but the summon’s polished seed case is completely omitted, so exact accessory continuity fails.

Original-resolution inspection places the complete head-and-hair unit at approximately 30.5% of standing figure height, below the required 32–36% band; the figure therefore reads too tall at roughly 3.3 heads.
Exactly one figure appears with the complete hair silhouette, head, both hands, both legs, both feet, mantle edges, and grounding shadow fully inside generous parchment margins.
The planted staggered stance, bent empty arms, compact layered silhouette, and forward three-quarter orientation read clearly as a grounded weaponless ready-idle at combat-icon scale.

The simple mantle, tunic, divided layers, and practical laced boots remain ordinary mortal attire. No weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect appears.
